run.display_title: Merge verified guest shutdown provenance into SPSS integration

head_commit.message:
Merge verified guest shutdown provenance into SPSS integration

Preserve the exact four mainline runner, test, documentation and evidence
blobs, with their original modes. These paths do not overlap the SPSS change.
The stronger runner checks guest shutdown provenance without changing
original inputs or Android boot-success requirements.

The a3a6183 push and PR runs and all six actual artifact audits passed,
but native was not started before this runner update arrived. This combined
head needs its own CI and artifact qualification, and the native coordinator
must explicitly pin the updated boot_android.py before deployment.
